researchConsent.title: Optional oral-health research
researchConsent.description: Review the information below before choosing whether to participate.
researchConsent.purpose: This optional program supports research on oral-health screening and development or evaluation of research AI tools. It is not part of your clinical care.
researchConsent.data: If you agree, existing oral images and related screening information, such as symptoms, questionnaire responses, and screening labels, may be included in a research dataset.
researchConsent.use: Authorized research personnel may curate and review consented images and related information for research dataset preparation and research AI training or evaluation. Research outputs are not a diagnosis and must not guide your care.
researchConsent.privacy: The research dataset uses a keyed pseudonymous participant code instead of your direct patient ID. This is pseudonymization, not guaranteed anonymity: oral images or details may still identify you. Access is restricted and audited.
researchConsent.risks: The main foreseeable risk is unauthorized disclosure or re-identification of sensitive image or health information. You should not expect a direct personal benefit. The research may contribute to future knowledge, but no clinical benefit is promised.
researchConsent.voluntary: Participation is voluntary. Saying no or withdrawing will not affect your care, services, or relationship with your healthcare team.
researchConsent.withdrawal: You may withdraw here at any time. Withdrawal blocks future enrollment and further use through this application. Existing clinical records are not deleted or changed. Previously exported copies, completed analyses, or aggregate results may not be fully retrievable; any retention or deletion must follow the approved institutional policy.
researchConsent.governanceReady: Configured governance information. The application displays the details supplied by the institution; it does not independently verify ethics approval.
researchConsent.governanceUnavailable: Research participation is unavailable until the institution has obtained required governance approval and configured the approval reference, contact, and approved retention policy.
researchConsent.unavailableNote: You can review this information, but you cannot grant research consent while participation is unavailable.
researchConsent.consentLabel: I voluntarily agree to the use described above, including the separate research AI training purpose.
